title: wholesome tunisian chocolate tagine
description: a funky, springy, indulgent tunisian dish featuring white chocolate chips, perfect for special occasions or a sweet treat.
instructions: grind the pistachios, cocoa nibs, and coconut sugar in a mortar and pestle until finely ground.
in a large bowl, whisk together the ground mixture, almond milk, egg, and vanilla extract.
in a separate bowl, melt the coconut oil and white chocolate chips in the microwave or over a double boiler.
whisk the melted chocolate mixture into the ground mixture until well combined.
stir in the dark cocoa powder and almond extract.
pour the mixture into a small tagine or a small ceramic dish.
cover the tagine and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
remove the tagine from the refrigerator and garnish with fresh mint leaves.
serve the tagine chilled, garnished with additional fresh mint leaves if desired.
